newsitem.title: USA: Taubman Centers has two large blocks trade.
newsitem.headline: Taubman Centers has two large blocks trade.

text.p: Taubman Centers Inc said two large blocks of its stock, totalling 4.2 million shares, traded Friday, one for cash and one for usual three-day settlement, a company spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the company does not comment on stock moves. An average of about 50,000 shares traded daily from April through September, she said.
Friday is the record date for the company's $0.22 a share quarterly dividend, which will be paid October 18.
Shares of the Bloomfield Hills, Michigan-based real estate investment trust, which owns and operates regional shopping centers, were unchanged at 10-7/8 Friday.
